currentTransformation.title: Transform the real autonomous climb into a legible, cinematic, responsive expedition
currentTransformation.state: BUILDING COHESIVE CLIMB AND ENCOUNTER SLICE — QUALITY NOT EVALUATED
currentTransformation.promise: One coherent climb: monumental original 3D environments, grounded grip-to-landing motion, tactical visible decisions, understandable guardian danger and opt-in terrain-aware spatial sound, with a minimal in-game HUD.
currentTransformation.nextDecision: A safe wounded-climber health detour now links real seeded AI observations to character intent, in-world resource emphasis and opt-in traversal sound. The source-pinned workflow now requests 68-second unaccelerated baseline/candidate ascent, guardian and outcome/restart footage on desktop and phone. RUNS, ACTUAL CLIPS, AND THEIR VISUAL QUALITY HAVE NOT YET BEEN VERIFIED: inspect the GPU recordings and hostile/route readability before extending the whole-life-cycle character, combat and world transformation. Obtain five independent blind reviewers per LOOKS/FEELS/PLAYS plus real-device frame-time tails; retain NOT EVALUATED until every requirement is met.
currentTransformation.rejectedMicroMilestones: A green CI run, an isolated pose fix, a prettier screenshot or an extra UI icon never counts as a Gauntlet win.
